Description: The system shall record solar generation units (kWh) from smart meter feeds and allow prosumers to transfer surplus credits to neighbor accounts.
Acceptance Criteria:
Pass: Transferred credits deduct from the prosumer balance and apply to the neighbor billing statement.
Fail: Transfer exceeding balance.
Rationale: Enables accurate recording of solar generation and sharing of surplus solar credits.

Description: The system shall allow prosumer residents to view their available solar credit balance and transaction history.
Acceptance Criteria:
Pass: The system displays the current credit balance and previous transactions.
Fail: Incorrect or unavailable balance information is displayed.
Rationale: Allows prosumers to monitor their available credits and previous transactions.

Description: The system shall verify that a recipient account is eligible to receive transferred solar credits before completing a credit transfer.
Acceptance Criteria:
Pass: A transfer proceeds only when the recipient account is valid and eligible.
Fail: The system rejects transfers to invalid or ineligible recipient accounts.
Rationale: Prevents credits from being transferred to unauthorized or ineligible community accounts.

Description: The system shall track monthly utility billing offsets resulting from allocated solar credits.
Acceptance Criteria:
Pass: The system records and displays the correct billing offset based on allocated solar credits.
Fail: The displayed billing offset does not reflect the allocated credits.
Rationale: Enables tracking of the financial benefit obtained through solar credit allocation.

Description: The system shall allow the Co-op Manager to generate reports on solar generation, credit allocations, and billing offsets.
Acceptance Criteria:
Pass: The Co-op Manager can generate reports containing solar generation, credit allocation, and billing offset information.
Fail: Required information is missing or inaccurate.
Rationale: Helps the Co-op Manager monitor and manage community solar activities.

Description: The smart meter telemetry processing pipeline must validate and store hourly generation data for 500 households with 99.9% uptime.
Acceptance Criteria:
Pass: Benchmarking tests confirm the required latency and security standards under simulated peak load.
Fail: The system fails to meet the required performance or uptime.
Rationale: Ensures reliable processing of solar generation data at the required scale.

Description: The system shall ensure that only authorized users can access solar generation, credit, and billing information and perform credit allocation operations.
Acceptance Criteria:
Pass: All tested unauthorized access attempts to protected information and credit allocation operations are denied.
Fail: Any unauthorized user can access protected information or perform a restricted operation.
Rationale: Protects user data and prevents unauthorized credit transactions.
